art_direction: 穿黄色雨衣的小新在雨后水洼边探头，倒影与蓝紫雨色相映。
composition_variation: Create a charming gouache wallpaper of Shinnosuke Nohara leaning forward to examine his reflection in a tiny puddle. His iconic thick eyebrows remain visible beneath a yellow raincoat hood; he is fully dressed in raincoat, shorts, and red rubber boots. One hand gently holds his hood edge while the other rests at his side. Frame him centrally below a distant soft violet rain cloud, using teal pavement reflections, fine raindrops, and generous misty open sky. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
